channel.title: BridgePoint Automatic Research Briefs
channel.description: Quality-gated BridgePoint Intelligence research and market-readiness briefs.

item.title: Why nationwide property intelligence is a data-infrastructure problem, not just an AI model
item.description: The defensible work in property intelligence starts before scoring: source discovery, normalization, identity resolution, provenance, refresh and geography-aware quality gates.

item.title: Property intelligence for roofing contractors: what to verify before driving a territory
item.description: A practical buyer guide to property matching, source provenance, multi-signal evidence and field verification before a roofing team spends time in a territory.

item.title: Property intelligence for real estate operators: how to prioritize a portfolio without another raw lead list
item.description: A framework for turning fragmented property records and public signals into explainable portfolio and territory prioritization.

item.title: Restoration lead intelligence: why multi-signal property evidence beats a storm-only list
item.description: How restoration and mitigation teams can use weather as context while demanding property matching, provenance and independent evidence before prioritizing field work.

item.title: Why weather exposure is not the same thing as property damage
item.description: A practical explanation of how BridgePoint separates documented weather context from property-level evidence.
